requirements.requirement: The system must normalize all provider overall scores to a common 0–100 scale before comparison.
The system must normalize individual measure scores across providers using the same scale and method.
The system must compute a rank ordering of providers based on normalized overall scores.
The system must compute per-measure rankings for each provider relative to others in the comparison set.
The system must calculate score deltas between providers for each measure.
The system must identify and label a provider's relative strengths where its score exceeds the comparison average for a measure.
The system must identify and label a provider's relative weaknesses where its score falls below the comparison average for a measure.
The system must handle comparison sets of two or more providers without failure.
The system must handle missing measure values by excluding them from normalization calculations without causing errors.
The system must handle inconsistent measure availability across providers by computing comparisons only on shared measures.
The system must return a structured comparison output that includes normalized scores, rankings, deltas, and strength/weakness flags.
The system must preserve original raw scores alongside normalized values in the output.
The system must ensure normalization logic is deterministic given identical input data.
The system must flag ties in ranking when two or more providers have equal normalized scores.
The system must gracefully return an empty comparison result when fewer than two providers are supplied.
